ONBOARDING.TITLE: Welcome to Activities!
ONBOARDING.SUBTITLE: A new way to organize your work and never miss a commitment.
ONBOARDING.TASK_DESC: Create reminders and track actions you need to do: call a customer, send a proposal, follow up. You define the title, description, and time — it's that simple.
ONBOARDING.MESSAGE_DESC: Automate your communication! Choose the channel (WhatsApp, API, etc.), write the message, and set when it will be sent. At the scheduled time, the message is sent automatically to the contact.
ONBOARDING.FILTERS_DESC: Filter by status (Pending, Completed, Cancelled), activity type, assignee, and more. Find exactly what you need in seconds.
ONBOARDING.VIEWS_DESC: Switch between calendar view (to see everything over time) and list view (to focus on chronological order). Whatever makes the most sense for you, when you need it.
ONBOARDING.EXTRA_DESC: Use search to quickly find activities. Assign team members to work together. Create activities right from the contact profile in the CRM. Everything integrated so you can sell and support better.
